name: Create Content Note
description: Creates a content note. [See the documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_contentnote.htm) and [Set Up Notes](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sales.notes_admin_setup.htm&type=5).

configurable_props.name: docsInfo
configurable_props.content: [See the documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_contentnote.htm) for more information on available fields.

configurable_props.name: OwnerId
configurable_props.label: Owner ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the user who owns the note.

configurable_props.name: Content
configurable_props.label: Content
configurable_props.description: The content or body of the note, which can include properly formatted HTML or plain text.

configurable_props.name: IsReadOnly
configurable_props.label: Read Only
configurable_props.description: Indicates whether the note is read only.

configurable_props.name: LinkedEntityId
configurable_props.label: Linked Entity ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the linked object. Can include Chatter users, groups, records (any that support Chatter feed tracking including custom objects), and Salesforce CRM Content libraries.

configurable_props.name: ShareType
configurable_props.label: Share Type
configurable_props.description: The permission granted to the user of the shared file in a library. This is determined by the permission the user already has in the library.

configurable_props.name: Visibility
configurable_props.label: Visibility
configurable_props.description: Specifies whether this file is available to all users, internal users, or shared users.
